initialPatch.selectionPolicy: match candidate and seed, then fall back to the candidate's deepest witness

configuration.shellDefinition: minimum face-adjacency distance from the root among owners of exposed faces
configuration.deadFaceRule: an exposed face below the requested shell depth with no currently legal face-mate is a failed shell obligation and is pruned

interpretation: Completing a finite shell while avoiding permanently unfillable exposed faces is necessary but not sufficient for an infinite face-to-face tiling. Exhaustion under these exact obligations is a non-tiling certificate; a time or node limit is inconclusive.
